change: The Implicit Slope Workshop: implicit differentiation

mutations.name: the circle's y′ loses its minus sign
the ellipse forgets the 4
the tilted curve skips the product rule
a point falls off the ellipse
two tilted points swap order
the nudge steps only one side
mutations.find: l=this.yAt(x-h,y), r=this.yAt(x+h,y); return {h, l, r, s:(r-l)/(2*h)};
mutations.replace: l=this.yAt(x,y), r=this.yAt(x+h,y); return {h, l, r, s:(r-l)/(2*h)};

mutations.name: the flat tangent is called the top everywhere
mutations.find: at the very ${y>0?'top':'bottom'} of the curve.
mutations.replace: at the very top of the curve.

mutations.name: the radius sentence is dropped
the tangent is drawn along the radius
the curve is drawn too big
the radius is drawn on every curve
the climb goal takes a falling tangent
a goal is met where it opens
mutations.find:
{id:'egg', t:'On the ellipse, find its top or bottom.', toast:'Found the top of the ellipse',
     ok:K=>K.si===1 && K.nd()[0]===0},

{id:'egg', t:'On the ellipse, find its top or bottom.', toast:'Found the top of the ellipse',
     ok:K=>K.nd()[0]===0 || K.si===0},
